verdict.rationale: A plugin platform that connects agents to external services could reasonably offer scoped, least-privilege credentials, so the axis applies. The evidence pack does not show users issuing such credentials. Sign in with ChatGPT only shares name, email and profile picture, and explicitly grants no data access. Plugins can prompt users to connect an external service, and the marketplace lists authentication policies, but neither involves minting scoped API keys or tokens for an agent.
